env_lead: Everything JGates needs to run the checks without touching your machine. Each part shows its state and the one action that fixes it; nothing runs until you ask.
env_not_ready: {count, plural, one {# part of the environment needs attention.} other {# parts of the environment need attention.}}
env_three_states: Environment ready, plan valid and result passed are different states: this screen only speaks of the first.
env_job_failed: It did not work. See the reason above and try again.
env_engine_ready: Docker {version} is running, with {memory} of memory and {cpus, plural, one {# CPU} other {# CPUs}}.
env_engine_low-memory: Docker has little memory for some checks.
env_image_in_image: JGates is running inside the tools: there is nothing to download.
env_image_missing: The JGates tools have not been downloaded yet.
env_image_version-mismatch: The downloaded tools are from another JGates version.
env_image_unknown: The tools could not be read: Docker did not answer.
env_tools_count: {shown} of {total, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}}
env_data_fresh: Every vulnerability database is at most {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} old.
env_data_stale: Some vulnerability data is out of date.
env_data_missing: The vulnerability data has not been downloaded yet.
env_data_threshold: A database counts as old after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
env_deps_none: No component of this project needs prepared dependencies.
env_deps_ready: {count, plural, one {# set of dependencies is ready.} other {# sets of dependencies are ready.}}
env_deps_not_ready: The project's dependencies have not been prepared yet.
env_deps_none_detail: When the project has components with a dependency file, they show here.
env_extension_present: {count, plural, one {# own image available.} other {# own images available.}}
env_extension_none: No own image. Only the JGates tools are used.
env_extension_none_detail: An own image adds your tools, registered in tools.yml.
env_services_configured: {count, plural, =0 {Services configured, using the compose files Docker Compose finds.} one {Services configured in # compose file.} other {Services configured in # compose files.}}
env_services_none: No services configured. Only the checks that need no services run.
env_services_selected_auto: the ones the checks ask for
env_codeql_unknown: Download the JGates tools to find out whether CodeQL is prepared.
env_codeql_terms_link: Read the CodeQL terms on GitHub
env_codeql_accept: I have read and accept the GitHub CodeQL terms.
env_codeql_why: CodeQL is supplied by you: JGates does not include it. After you accept the terms it is downloaded from the official release, checked and kept in a Docker volume.
env_recipe_hint: Copy and run this in your terminal. JGates does not run it for you.
